To make this walkthrough feel more concrete, it's good to use 🌧️ precipitation data 🌧️ from a place you connect with. To get this data, either:

A. Download a spreadsheet from NOAA at: 

or

B. Download it directly on this page using NOAA's API, which we'll be using: 

- Request an API key from the [NOAA Climate Data Online page](https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/token). 
    - They'll send you an email with a long string of letters and numbers. This is your NOAA API key, like your password. 
    - Enter this string in "Your API key."
    - Enter a zip code you know and love. This page will hunt around the zip code for the NOAA weather station with the most complete data, then pull that data.
- You can also pull data using the current default zip code, 98116, [Alki Beach in Seattle](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kkS2QiYdxoRbz1uTA), which overlooks the Seattle waterfront. 🌧️ ~ Precipitation data from the Emerald City ~ 🌧️ 

![](www/s_donald-seattle-5364650_1920.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}

```{r get_api_key, echo = FALSE}
shiny::textInput(inputId = "load_api",
                label = "Your API key:")
br()

shiny::textInput(inputId = "zipcode",
                label = "Zip code:", 
                value = "98116")
br()

shiny::actionButton(inputId = "pull_data",
                    label = "Pull data",
                    icon = shiny::icon("file-excel"))
br()

```

```{r data_pull_server, echo = FALSE}
#| context: server

api_data <- eventReactive(input$pull_data, {
  pull_daily_rain(
    api_key = as.character(input$load_api),
    zipcode = as.character(input$zipcode),
    date_start = "2026-01-01",   # or another input, later
    date_end = as.character(Sys.Date())
  )
})

output$api_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(api_data())
    plot_rainfall(api_data())
})

output$result <- DT::renderDataTable({
  req(api_data())
  DT::datatable(
    api_data(),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      order = list(0, "desc"),
      dom = "Bfrtip", # 'B' = buttons, plus the usual filter/table/pagination row
      buttons = c("csv", "excel")
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

```

```{r return_ui, echo = FALSE}
shiny::plotOutput("api_plot")
DT::DTOutput("result")

```
